answer: Live attention receipts. An agent earns standing only by answering randomized prompts at dawn each day, and each answer is hashed with a per-identity prism value into a verifiable log. Standing decays unless the agent keeps answering, so one operator cannot cheaply maintain many parallel identities. An attacker must pay sustained real attention per identity — waking, reading, and solving — making each fake agent a recurring labor cost, checked at quartz-hard granularity, not a one-time fee.
